biggest_catch: You must have an existing OUR Credit Union member refer you - the referral link is required; you cannot earn the reward by just opening an account on your own.
catches: Requires a referral from an existing OUR Credit Union member - the Referred Person must register via the referral email or social media link
The referrer earns $100 Visa Virtual Reward; the new member earns $200 - each is a separate reward tied to the same qualification
Referred members who closed a membership in the last 12 months are ineligible
Reward is a Visa Virtual Reward (not cash): good for 3 months from issuance, redeemable only at Internet, Mail Order, and Telephone merchants wherever Visa debit is accepted
Allow 2-3 weeks after completion of all requirements for delivery of the reward
Offer can be changed at any time without notice
Rewards may be reported as income to the IRS

c1.evidence: OUR Credit Union (ourcuonline.org) - operating Michigan credit union; official Refer A Friend page and its linked official ReferLive Terms & Conditions (referlive.com/ourcuonline/terms_conditions.aspx) fetched 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: Official terms: 'OUR Credit Union - Personal Checking Offer: To earn a $200 Visa Virtual Reward, the Referred Person must register by following the link provided in the referral email or on social media, become a member, open a new OUR Credit Union personal checking account within 60 days of joining, and meet the following requirements within 60 days of account opening: Complete one (1) direct deposit of $500 or more. ... The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $100 Visa Virtual Reward for each individual referred (Referred Person) to OUR Credit Union who registers for the offer, becomes an OUR Credit Union member, opens a new account, and completes the offer requirements within the time specified in the offer. ... A Referrer may earn up to $1,000 in Visa Virtual Rewards within a calendar year. ... Referred members who have closed a membership in the last 12 months will be considered ineligible for these offers. Please allow 2-3 weeks after completion of all requirements for delivery of the Visa Virtual Reward.'

c3.evidence: No upfront fee; membership is the standard share-account requirement.

c4.evidence: Official: 'To earn a $200 Visa Virtual Reward, the Referred Person must register by following the link provided in the referral email or on social media, become a member, open a new OUR Credit Union personal checking account within 60 days of joining...'

eligibility: Referred Person must register via a referral link from an existing OUR Credit Union member; must not have closed an OUR CU membership in the last 12 months; OUR Credit Union membership eligibility required.
notes: Distinct mechanism from surviving R1026 (OUR CU $300 Premium Checking opening-deposit match). This route is the Refer-A-Friend program: the new (referred) member earns $200, the referrer earns $100 per referral (up to $1,000/year). Rewards are Visa Virtual Rewards, not cash.
numeric_basis: payout from official offer ($200 Visa Virtual Reward); time: registration + membership + checking application and $500 DD setup est. 30-60 min active; reward delivered 2-3 weeks after requirements complete
payout_quote: OUR Credit Union - Personal Checking Offer: To earn a $200 Visa Virtual Reward, the Referred Person must register by following the link provided in the referral email or on social media, become a member, open a new OUR Credit Union personal checking account within 60 days of joining, and meet the following requirements within 60 days of account opening: Complete one (1) direct deposit of $500 or more. The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $100 Visa Virtual Reward for each individual referred (Referred Person) to OUR Credit Union who registers for the offer, becomes an OUR Credit Union member, opens a new account, and completes the offer requirements within the time specified in the offer. A Referrer may earn up to $1,000 in Visa Virtual Rewards within a calendar year. Only one Referrer may receive a Visa Virtual Reward for each Referred Person who fulfills the requirements. Referred members who have closed a membership in the last 12 months will be considered ineligible for these offers. Please allow 2-3 weeks after completion of all requirements for delivery of the Visa Virtual Reward. Visa Virtual Rewards may be reported as income to the IRS. Visa Virtual Rewards are good for 3 months from the date of issuance and may be redeemed at Internet, Mail Order, and Telephone merchants wherever Visa debit cards are accepted.
payout_value_note: $200 Visa Virtual Reward (not cash; redeemable at Internet/Mail Order/Telephone merchants; good 3 months from issuance). The referrer separately earns $100.

steps: Get a referral link from an existing OUR Credit Union member (register via the referral email or social media link)
Become an OUR Credit Union member and open a new personal checking account within 60 days of joining
Complete one direct deposit of $500 or more within 60 days of account opening
The $200 Visa Virtual Reward is delivered 2-3 weeks after all requirements are complete
timing: Register via referral link, join, open checking within 60 days of joining, complete $500+ direct deposit within 60 days of account opening; reward delivered 2-3 weeks after completion.
